reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing exported getScheduledAmount from shared/schedules.ts, passing the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: Added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity, the API's existing schedule mapping layer.

scope.why: One type field and one mapping line; nothing unrelated (import placement is slightly out of the file's ordering but trivial).

maintainability.why: The API value tracks the app's expected-amount rule automatically through the shared helper.
